bridge.original_E009_GLM_student: reuse accepted E023 result and summary; zero scientific replay/rescore
bridge.algorithms: Exact E023 source/defaults, restricted native/TNF proposals, contextual rerank, sparse density and weighted marker selection
bridge.depth_semantics: Positive-evidence endpoints only; measured all-zero rows remain observed but omitted from original E023 pair depth. Not the later E027 cozero/zero-positive rule.
bridge.biological_hypothesis: A different graph/forest/antichain bundle recovers the known E009 vector signal and may transfer to the current Oral measured-depth learner
bridge.keep: All three student modes have no R95 or target-90 regression versus E030; Oral R95 increases by at least 0.005 absolute. The reused E009 GLM anchor is not new evidence.
bridge.abandon: Neither newly evaluated student mode (E009 no-GLM, Oral no-GLM) improves R95 or target-90 over E030; no common promotion
bridge.modify: All other valid mixed outcomes; preserve every failed criterion. Choose no per-dataset winner route.
bridge.comparison_scope: Downstream bundle on matched within-mode learning; not graph-versus-selection isolation or full Oral GLM transfer

learning.common_initial_downstream: E030 exact policy for all three modes, root/pre/post retained
learning.initialization: admitted bootstrap online/EMA/predictor/buffers/Adam moments and counters; fresh seed11 continuation RNG explicitly declared
learning.positives: all available real same-parent DNA views plus cautious cached inter-parent proposals; no invented crop depth
learning.control: E023 bridge is the sole selective companion; no loss/seed/grid campaign
learning.keep: All three student modes have no R95/target-90 regression versus E030; at least one primary mode reaches E023 E009 or E026 Oral anchor. Retain teacher comparisons and every target loss.
learning.abandon: Neither primary mode improves R95 or target-90 versus E030
learning.no_causal_claim: Continuation exposure, initialization, soft preservation and confidence form a bundle; not proof isolating marker loss
learning.relation_normalizer: Original source-pair slots/permutation; withheld positives do not rescale remaining negative force.

anchors.exact_values: Use bound accepted summaries and integer target unions, not rounded display values in decisions

truth.oral: provided-origin oracle plus unchanged known-shared sensitivity, not exhaustive unique sequence
truth.secondary: Per-bin conservative completeness/impurity and threshold-based HQ/MQ/LQ; RNA unchecked, not formal MIMAG HQ
